name: Quantity stepper
description: The control that sets how many of an item an employee takes, one step per tap: the Add button while the quantity is zero, and a solid green − quantity + group once the item is in the cart.

item.description: The item's name, used to name the buttons for screen readers.

quantity.description: The quantity in the cart, such as "2". Leave it out when the quantity is zero, to show the Add button.

atLimit.description: The quantity has reached the available stock, so + is turned off.
